links.comparator_used: Models trained on the single primary cohort only and tested cross-cohort on the independent set
links.outcome: AUPRC on GDM prediction (mixed-domain training vs single-cohort training with cross-cohort testing)
links.effect: Mixed-domain (oracle) training AUPRC recovered to 0.944-0.978, versus cross-cohort AUPRC of 0.180-0.266 for classical models and 0.167-0.216 for contrastive models trained on one cohort
links.tradeoff: This was an oracle experiment, described as a non-deployment setting, so the gain is not shown to be achievable in real deployment.
links.quote: In an oracle mixed-domain experiment (non-deployment setting), when training includes data from both cohorts, AUPRC recovers to 0.944-0.978, confirming that model capacity is not the bottleneck.

design_hint: domain adaptation and preprocessing choices for cross-cohort transfer
